name: Caffe Umbria Arco Etrusco, 12oz
description: Founded in Seattle in 2001, Caffe Umbria selects only the best varietals from coffee growing countries to produce each of their proprietary blends. Blended and tasted for drip coffee, it consists of beans from Brazil, Colombia and Mexico. Full bodied with low acidity, it has a long finish of sweet stout. We are proud to serve Arco Etrusco in our cafe for drip coffee.

name: Caffe Umbria Bizzarri, 12oz
description: Founded in Seattle in 2001, Caffe Umbria selects only the best varietals from coffee growing countries to produce each of their proprietary blends. This signature blend was named after owner and master roaster Emanuele Bizzarri. A medium-dark roast, it consists of beans from Peru, El Salvador and Uganda. An incredibly versatile blend, the deep fruity acidity helps balance flavor when enjoyed with sweet milk or cream. Great for drip, French press, and pour over.

name: Caffe Umbria Gusto Crema, 12oz
description: Founded in Seattle in 2001, Caffe Umbria selects only the best varietals from coffee growing countries to produce each of their proprietary blends. Gusto Crema is their flagship blend. A medium roast that has been blended and tasted for espresso, it features beans from Brazil, Guatemala and Colombia. Creamy in body with a sweetness that lasts through the finish, it is the only coffee we use in our cafe for espresso. It is also fantastic in a French press ground fine and made strong.

name: Caffe Umbria Mezzanotte Decaf, 12oz
description: Founded in Seattle in 2001, Caffe Umbria selects only the best varietals from coffee growing countries to produce each of their proprietary blends. Mezzanotte (mid-night) is a dark roast decaf made with a blend of beans from Colombia and Costa Rica. It is creamy in body with notes of milk chocolate and hazelnut. Great for espresso, French press and pour over.

name: Caffe Umbria Terra Sana, 12oz
description: Founded in Seattle in 2001, Caffe Umbria selects only the best varietals from coffee growing countries to produce each of their proprietary blends. Tere Sana (Healthy Ground) is a medium roast that is certified organic and fair-trade. Blended with beans from small cooperatives in Mexico, Peru and East Timor, it is artfully blended to balance crisp acidity with deep notes of cocoa. Perfect for drip coffee.

name: Outer Dark Form and Void Flagship Espresso Blend, 12oz
description:
Outer Dark is a small roaster out of Tacoma, Washington that believes coffee is for everyone and embraces the utilitarian nature of coffee. while they put a lot of thought and energy into creating their unique version of the best possible cup, they mostly think coffee makes existing on this planet a lot more enjoyable. We agree!

Form and Void is their flagship espresso blend, bold and expressive, yet bright enough to shine through in any assortment of milk.

name: Outer Dark The Feels,12oz
description:
Outer Dark is a small roaster out of Tacoma, Washington that believes coffee is for everyone and embraces the utilitarian nature of coffee. while they put a lot of thought and energy into creating their unique version of the best possible cup, they mostly think coffee makes existing on this planet a lot more enjoyable. We agree!

The Feels roast runs dark, walking a fine line between being both bold and sweet while still highlighting the origin character.

name: Spella Caffe Espresso, 12oz
tagline: Small batch roasted by hand in Portland, OR
description:
Raised above his grandmother's European bakery in Chicago, Andrea Spella first knew espresso as the thick stuff brewed on a stovetop and drunk with pastry after school. This childhood ritual, steeped as it was in old-world tradition, isn't far from the espresso experience Andrea has cultivated over the past ten years in his caffè. Andrea works closely with family-owned coffee farms and co-operatives in India, Latin America, and Africa to ensure the highest quality of beans find their way to our roastery. Strong relationships with coffee growers are the foundation of Spella Caffè.

Beans are roasted in small batches?eleven pounds at a time?at their roasting spot in Southeast Portland. This method of roasting brings out the unique, inherent qualities of each variety, and allows them to find the sweet spot of each batch.

Rossalina Espresso has a thick, lush body, full of crema. It has nutty, caramel tones with a healthy amount of licorice and anisette.

Rossalina is the bean you'll find pulled on the espresso machines at our wholesale accounts - she's a beauty to work with!

name: Jaipur Avenue Masala Chai Tea Mix, 11.6oz
description: Great while at home, on the go, or in our cafe, Seattle based Jaipur Avenue's Chai Mixes are conveniently packaged in single serving pouches. To best enjoy this spicy and calming Chai, add hot water for a soothing chai, or cold milk and ice for a refreshing warm weather drink.

name: Olympia Coffee Big Truck Blend, 12oz
description: The roasters at Olympia Coffee devote constant attention to their Big Truck blend year round. Although the green coffee varietals change depending on the season & harvest period, the flavor profile remains the same - notes of sweet chocolate & ripe berries, with a dense, heavy body. Great for espresso or French press!

name: Olympia Coffee Little Buddy Blend, 12oz
description: Used at their espresso blend at Olympia Coffee's retail locations, this blend was named after a teenagers first car. Roasted and blended for an intense flavor and sweetness, it has notes of stone fruit & sweet chocolate. Perfect for your home espresso machine, or for French press brewed strong.

name: Olympia Coffee Morning Sun, 12oz
description: Morning Sun is Olympia Coffee Roasters version of a rich and delicious morning coffee. From their Colombian coffee producers, Morning Sun is their darkest roast, but you won't find any smoky flavors, just chocolatey and bold!

name: Olympia Coffee Northwesterly, 12oz
description: Northwest is best: especially where coffee's involved. Inspired by the Pacific Northwest’s specialty coffee scene, their newest, darkest roast captures the essence of warmth and nostalgia. Northwesterly Blend wraps you in comfort, whether brewed in your favorite mug or pulled as a rich, bold espresso.

name: Olympia Coffee Sweetheart, 12oz
description: Olympia Coffee San Sebastian coffees are part of the most complex coffee project they have undertaken. A project intended to develop lasting, quality-focused relationships between farmer and roaster. The Sweetheart roast profile is roasted just a little bit darker with a more developed body. This roast profile is ideal for espresso or a richer brewed coffee option.

name: Steven Smith British Brunch Tea, 1.48oz
description: Steven Smith Tea sources the finest teas and botanicals from India, China, Sri Lanka and Africa. In most cases, these are growers, exporters and tea brokers they have worked with for over 15 years. These great teas are then packed by hand in Portland, OR. Brahmin is a rich blend of full-bodied Indian Assam teas paired with succulent Ceylon Dimbula, intense and floral Ceylon Uva and a touch of smoky China Keemun from Anhui. It is the perfect breakfast tea, that is great any time of day.

name: Steven Smith Lord Bergamot Tea, 1.2oz
description: Steven Smith Tea sources the finest teas and botanicals from India, China, Sri Lanka and Africa. In most cases, these are growers, exporters and tea brokers they have worked with for over 15 years. These great teas are then packed by hand in Portland, OR. Lord Bergamot is a flavor akin to traditional Earl Grey, but with a superior flavor. It is the combination of fragrant Ceylon Dimbula and Uva that are artfully combined with select teas from India's Assam valley, then scented with the flavor of bergamot from Calabria, Italy.

name: Steven Smith Meadow Tea, 0.85oz
description: Steven Smith Tea sources the finest teas and botanicals from India, China, Sri Lanka and Africa. In most cases, these are growers, exporters and tea brokers they have worked with for over 15 years. These great teas are then packed by hand in Portland, OR. Their Meadow is a caffeine free blend of golden Egyptian chamomile flowers and mildly stimulating, fragrant hyssop joined with smooth Cape rooibos, rose petals and linden flowers.

name: Miro Tea Yamabuki Ceremonial Matcha, 30g
description: Miro's Ceremonial Matcha achieves a perfect balance between fragrant notes, umami richness, and gentle astringency - a true embodiment of Japanese tea craftsmanship.

name: Miro Tea Yamabuki Homare Matcha, 30g
description: Miro's Homare Ceremonial Matcha was produced in Uji Japan. They were seeking a ceremonial grade matcha that displayed a balance of sweet and savory while showcasing something different. They fell in love with this one because not only is it smooth with a comforting rich body, it displays a lingering floral sweetness that makes it distinctive from other matcha.

name: Attibassi Espresso Italiano Beans, 500g
description: Attibassi has been making exceptional pastries and coffee in Bologna, Italy since 1918. Their Espresso Italiano is a blend of beans from Africa, India, Asia, and Brazil. The result is a coffee that is sweet and rich in taste, and fruity and floral in aroma. Great for your home espresso machine, stovetop or French press.

name: Attibassi Espresso Italiano Coffee, 250g

name: MarketSpice Original Cinnamon-Orange Tea, 24pc
description: From our Pike Place Market neighbors just a few doors away - this unique, spicy, and naturally sweet tea has become world famous. Enjoy hot or cold!

name: Medaglia d'Oro Instant Espresso Powder, 2oz
description: This is the original. The quick route to adding some extra body to the coffee you are trying to enjoy but can't because your friend doesn't make it strong enough. It is also what you use to make the coffee that you soak your ladyfingers in when making your famous tiramisu!

name: Steven Smith Fez Tea, 1.3oz
description: Steven Smith Tea sources the finest teas and botanicals from India, China, Sri Lanka and Africa. In most cases, these are growers, exporters and tea brokers they have worked with for over 15 years. These great teas are then packed by hand in Portland, OR. Fez uses rare green teas from China combined with aromatic spearmint grown in the Pacific Northwest and a hint of lemon myrtle from Australia. Fez artfully evokes old Morocco, and tastes best when shared with friends while lounging on pillows.

name: Teapigs Chamomile, 15ct
description: Teapigs was born in 2006 with one mission in mind - to get a tea drinking nation to start drinking real tea again. There is chamomile, and there is chamomile. This is chamomile. Made with whole, pure chamomile flowers, so sweet it hardly resembles a regular chamomile. Great any time of day!

name: Teapigs English Breakfast, 15ct
description: Teapigs was born in 2006 with one mission in mind - to get a tea drinking nation to start drinking real tea again. In Britain, black tea is so 'regular' that it's often referred to as 'normal tea'. The reality is that it can be far from normal, with each variety of black tea being packed with a delicious unique flavor. This is a top quality version of "regular tea", although there's nothing regular here, drink with milk morning, noon and night.

name: Teapigs Lemon & Ginger, 15ct
description: Teapigs was born in 2006 with one mission in mind - to get a tea drinking nation to start drinking real tea again. This delicious herbal blend is made from pure lemongrass, lemon peel and ginger root. Light, refreshing & flavorful - great any time of day!
